source_title: Save $200 Off the 27" Samsung Odyssey OLED G6 240Hz Gaming Monitor Ahead of Black Friday
source_excerpt:
Includes a 3 year warranty that covers OLED burn-in.
Ahead of Black Friday, Amazon is offering a great deal on a well-rated OLED gaming monitor. You can pick up a 27" Samsung Odyssey OLED G6 QHD 240Hz gaming monitor, which normally retails for $600, for just $399.99 with free delivery after a $200 off instant discount. This is the lowest price I've seen all year.
Save $200 Off the 27" Samsung Odyssey OLED G6 Gaming Monitor
27" Samsung Odyssey OLED G6 QHD 240Hz Gaming Monitor
The Samsung Odyssey OLED G6 is a current generation (2026) 27" QD-OLED monitor with 2560x1440 resolution, which equates to a pixel density of 109ppi. It's sharp enough for both gaming and general workstation use with excellent text clarity. This monitor is equipped with Samsung's quantum dot (QD) OLED panel. A QD OLED panel is brighter and has a wider color gamut than the more common W-OLED panel. OLED monitors in general offer superior image quality compared to other monitors thanks to a near-instantaneous response time, true black levels, and near-infinite contrast ratio.
Most "budget" OLED monitors have a native 120Hz-165Hz refresh rate, but the Samsung Odyssey OLED G6 boasts a native 240Hz refresh rate. This makes it an excellent option for first person shooters, sports games, or any other game that involves high-speed motion or requires twitch-like reflexes. You'll need to make sure you have an appropriate graphics card to achieve 240fps at 1440p, ideally something like an RTX 5070 Ti or AMD Radeon RX 9070 XT , although an RTX 5070 should be able to hit this target in older games like Fortnite, Apex Legends, Counter-Strike, or Valorant.
Samsung also backs the monitor up with a 3 year warranty that covers OLED burn-in.
